turns.text: Show me the calls I have with Aunt and give them back.
turns.rephrase: I mean: find the calls with Aunt and return the calls.

turns.gold:
PROCEDURE calls_with(person:PERSON)
$v0 = FIND CALL WHERE SELF.WHO={person}
RETURN $v0
END
turns.name: calls_with

turns.text: REQUEST which calls are with Zoe
